items.markdown:
[PDRN Has Quickly Taken Over Skin Care](https://www.allure.com/story/what-is-pdrn-skin-care-salmon-sperm) is `a popular regenerative ingredient made from purified DNA fragments` . It is traditionally sourced from salmon or trout sperm, though vegan, plant-based versions now exist.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/what-is-pdrn-skin-care-salmon-sperm)[[2]](https://www.cultbeauty.co.uk/blog/what-is-pdrn/)[[3]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/pages/pdrn)

### What is PDRN?

- **Full Name:** Polydeoxyribonucleotide.
- **Origin:** Extracted from fish DNA through heavy purification.
- **History:** Used for decades in medicine to heal wounds, burns, and ulcers before entering the beauty world.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5405115/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polydeoxyribonucleotide)[[3]](https://www.allure.com/story/what-is-pdrn-skin-care-salmon-sperm)[[4]](https://www.cultbeauty.co.uk/blog/what-is-pdrn/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)

### How It Works

- **Boosts Collagen:** It wakes up skin cells called fibroblasts to rebuild firm skin.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)[[2]](https://www.skinlaundry.com/blog/PDRN)
- **Improves Blood Flow:** It helps form new blood vessels to deliver nutrients and a healthy glow.[[1]](https://www.skinlaundry.com/blog/PDRN)
- **Soothes Skin:** It has strong anti-inflammatory properties to reduce redness and irritation.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXfJsmDERtm/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.skinlaundry.com/blog/PDRN)

### Topicals vs. Injectables

- **Injections:** Administered by professionals in clinics to deeply repair tissue and boost elasticity.[[1]](https://www.skinceuticals.com/pdrn.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)
- **Topicals:** Serums and creams applied at home. They hydrate and soothe the outer skin layer, though experts debate how deeply the large DNA molecules can penetrate.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BLKR6a44EBw&t=14)[[2]](https://www.skinceuticals.com/pdrn.html)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXfJsmDERtm/?hl=en)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)

If you want to know more, let me know:

- Are you looking for **topical serums** or **clinical treatments**?
- What specific **skin concern** are you trying to treat?
